notes: «أبي رحمة الله» : the bare «أبي» is a relation with no name (rule 7); the blessing is left out and the name is not supplied
«يعقوب بن يزيد… …» : the ellipsis marks a lacuna in the text; no transmitter is written there, so none is filled (rule 9)
«سمعت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام يقول» : the Imam is the last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
